# D6fault — Security Researcher & YouTuber

> Official site of D6fault (https://d6fault.dev): an American security researcher specializing in web security, ICS/OT security, firmware reverse engineering, and responsible disclosure in government and corporate systems

D6fault began practical training on TryHackMe at age 13 (300+ rooms completed) and by 14 had reported security issues affecting U.S. government entities including the Department of Defense, Department of Education, Department of Health and Human Services, and the Department of Energy. Focus areas: ICS/OT security, firmware reverse engineering, web application security, penetration testing, ethical disclosure.

## Pages

- [Home](https://d6fault.dev/): Overview of research, CVEs, publications, and hall-of-fame listings.
- [Blog](https://d6fault.dev/blog/): Technical vulnerability write-ups and disclosure reports.

## Key content

### Published CVEs

- CVE-2026-23695 — Stored XSS in Cockpit CMS <= 2.14.0 (Set field type Display template; Vue v-html; authenticated). Severity: medium. https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-23695
- CVE-2026-46393 — SSRF in @haxtheweb/haxcms-nodejs via the authenticated createSite endpoint. Severity: high, 7.1. https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-46393
- CVE-2026-46401 — Session fixation in HAXcms < 26.0.0: tokens remain valid after logout, enabling hijacking. Severity: medium, 5.3. https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-46401
- CVE-2026-95675 — Unauthenticated OS command injection (CWE-78) in the D-Link DAP-1360 formSystemCheck handler at POST /apply.cgi (ipv4_ping parameter), leading to pre-auth root RCE. Severity: critical, 9.3. https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-95675

### Write-ups

- [OS Command Injection in D-Link DAP-1360 formSystemCheck Handler](https://d6fault.dev/blog/dlink-dap1360-os-command-injection/): Unauthenticated pre-auth root RCE via command injection in bin/httpd's formSystemCheck handler at POST /apply.cgi?formSystemCheck; tested on latest firmware (Rev. F, v6.14b01).
